title: Auth & scope gating for edit mode
description: Edit mode is dev-only by default (import.meta.env.DEV). Stronger protection: require KYBER_EDIT_MODE env flag. For deploy with edit-mode enabled (advanced): basic auth, scope gating to specific page sets, audit log. Originally kyber-3fh.8.5.

title: Astro /__edit endpoint + loader invalidation
description: POST endpoint at host site: /__edit/{block-id}. Receives new markdown, calls write-back service (.8.2), then calls Astro Content Layer invalidate API to mark the affected kb collection entry stale. Astro HMR picks it up and re-renders. The invalidate hook is the engine-side piece; the endpoint scaffolding is host-side. Originally kyber-3fh.8.4.

title: Edit-mode UI overlay (host-site)
description: Site-specific Astro components for the edit UI: hover affordances, click-to-edit modal, save handler. Only active when import.meta.env.DEV; additionally gated by KYBER_EDIT_MODE env flag. Lives in each host-site repo. Could extract to @kyber/astro-edit-overlay if a second site needs it; YAGNI for now. Originally kyber-3fh.8.3.

title: Block-level write-back service (TG + LogSeq)
description: Service: given a block-id + new markdown content, locate the source (which TG library doc + which block within), update TG (or LogSeq during migration), optionally update LogSeq anchor per kyber-3fh.6 manifest editor's per-page anchor-currency policy. Lives in PAI USER skill tree (engine doesn't write to source; the skill does). Originally kyber-3fh.8.2.

title: Preserve LogSeq block IDs through transformBody
description:
Today's transformBody strips id:: lines. Change: emit them as HTML data-block-id attrs on the resulting block-equivalent element (paragraph, list-item, heading). Round-trips: source has 'id:: 64fa...; → rendered HTML has

. Exposes addressable identity for each rendered piece, which the edit-mode UI uses to locate the source. Originally kyber-3fh.8.1.

title: In-place edit mode for projected sites
description: Parallel track to the agent-conversation loop. Where conversation is right for substantive edits, in-place edit is right for surgical edits (typos, wording tweaks). Toggle edit mode in browser; click element; inline-edit; POST to dev-server endpoint; backend updates source (TG-first per kyber-3fh.9 architecture); loader invalidates; Astro HMR re-renders. Architecture: block-IDs round-trip through transformBody as data-block-id HTML attrs (today's transform STRIPS them; that's the first sub-issue's job to change). Write-back service in PAI USER skill tree. /__edit endpoint + UI overlay in host site. Migrated from kyber-3fh.8 on 2026-04-28 as part of kbp-pd3 (engine bd issue migration).

title: Migrate kyber-3fh.* engine bd issues to this repo's tracker
description: Per the extraction plan (777westwood/Plans/please-plan-c-sparkling-tower.md), engine-specific bd issues currently in kyber's .beads/ should move here once the extraction settles. Review open kyber-3fh.* issues; close in kyber with note 'moved to kb-projection'; recreate here with engine-scoped descriptions. Out of scope: 777westwood-specific issues (stay in kyber for now), cross-cutting infrastructure issues that span N sites (stay in kyber).
close_reason: Migration complete 2026-04-28: 6 kyber-3fh.* issues closed as already-shipped (3fh.2, .9, .10, .11, .12, .15); 3fh.8 + 5 children migrated to kb-projection-nk3 epic + nk3.1-.5. kyber-3fh.7 stays in kyber (host-site work, not engine). kyber-3fh epic stays in kyber as historical context. Final open kyber-3fh.* count: 2 (parent epic + .7); final open kb-projection-* count: 8 (3 follow-ups + 5 in-place-edit-mode tree).

Currently consumed only by ~/commons/code/kyber/scripts/regression/777westwood-astro.ts. Drop legacy/ in v0.2.0 once that regression is retired or rewritten to consume the engine's current API. Update CHANGELOG, bump version, tag v0.2.0.

title: Public visibility flip — sensitivity sweep + gh repo edit
description: kb-projection is currently private (started private per the extraction plan). To flip public: (1) prose-pass on every committed file for sensitive references (paths, names, internal context); (2) review CHANGELOG + README for hygiene; (3) gh repo edit IanGordonOne/kb-projection --visibility public --accept-visibility-change-consequences. Engine code itself is unlikely to contain sensitive material based on extraction review, but a sweep before flip is the responsible move.
close_reason: Sensitivity sweep found site-specific patterns in src/filters/redact.ts; refactored to host-supplied rules (commit 83e0631 in kb-projection, 9e7ccee in 777westwood). Engine source-clean: zero hardcoded names/addresses/figures. Visibility flipped public via gh repo edit.
